Belgian Documents: Authorities and Price Bands

Every document in Belgium comes from a different office. This hub lists all six with the office that issues it and the observed band, so you can pick the right page before you open a chat.

Price bands differ by document by an order of magnitude and the checks differ completely. Read the office column before the price column, because the office tells you what the document is and the price only tells you what a seller hopes to get for it.

Belgian documents: the six offices

Issuing office by document.
DocumentOfficeObserved
Passportthe commune175–630 EUR
Driving Licencethe commune120–460 EUR
ID Cardthe commune85–290 EUR
Green Cardthe commune and the immigration office320–1020 EUR
Visaa Belgian embassy145–520 EUR
Residence Permitthe immigration office300–900 EUR

Two checks specific to Belgium

  • Check the electronic identity card for a working chip and confirm the national number modulo ninety seven checksum.
  • Confirm the passport data page and the chip symbol on the cover.

Local red flag

  • An identity card with a national number that fails the modulo ninety seven check.
